title: Applied ML labnotes (presubmit) - 2026-05-23
content:
Applied ML — weekly lab notes (presubmit) — 2026-05-23

Attendees: Priya, Jonah, Marta, Ethan (10:30 sync, 30m)
Context: working notes for quantization + eval runs for new 7B-family candidate (open-model fork) and onboarding checklist for Dedicated. Drafting before formal PR.

Top-level decisions
- Focus this sprint on two quant profiles: symmetric int8 (baseline) and hybrid int4+fp16 for KV cache hot-path. Target: keep >98% QA pass rate on smoke evals and p95 token latency below 60ms on a single A100-80GB equivalent host for batch=1.
- Skip aggressive activation-scaling tricks for now (too many moving pieces) — will revisit after stable evals.

Experiments run (5/18 — 5/22)
1) int8 symmetric (FK-1 profile)
   - Conversion: gguf export successful, all weights present.
   - Perf: mean per-token latency 45ms, p95 58ms, throughput single-stream ~22 tok/s.
   - Quality: 1k-shot synthetic QA suite: EM drop 2.1%, F1 drop 1.5% vs fp16 baseline. Cosine similarity (embeds) mean 0.987.
   - Notes: occasional hallucination on long-context (>1024) summarization; likely from quant noise in cross-attn layers.
2) hybrid int4 emb/key-split (FK-2 profile)
   - Conversion: required custom quantize-step for attention projection matrices; saved patch in workspace.
   - Perf: mean latency 33ms, p95 49ms, throughput ~30 tok/s.
   - Quality: EM drop 4.8%, F1 drop 3.6%. Degraded on math problems and multi-step reasoning.
   - Observed KV-cache divergence in repeated-generation stress test (determinism variance ~0.4% across runs).
3) fp16 baseline (control)
   - Perf: mean latency 62ms, p95 80ms on same infra (slower due to memory pressure and nvlink config differences).
   - Quality: reference for all metrics.

Quick interpretation
- Hybrid int4 gives strong latency wins but has nontrivial quality regressions on reasoning tasks. Could be acceptable for retrieval-augmented generation where downstream reranker filters outputs.
- Symmetric int8 is a safer default for GA/Dedicated customers who prioritize quality.
- Need targeted per-layer calibration for attention + MLP layers to reduce reasoning regressions in int4.

Onboarding checklist status (for model -> hosted/dedicated)
- Conversion: gguf completed (PR #3456).
- Eval harness: added 12 new prompt sets under /evals/quant-sanity (unit tests + regression tests).
- CI: added nightly quant-eval job (runs at 03:00 UTC). Failing thresholds: >3% EM drop flagged.
- Perf profiling: perf traces captured for both FK-1 and FK-2; uploaded to perf-db with tags "may23-quant".
- Security: model license review done; legal sign-off pending (Marta).
- Docs: short-form runbook drafted (see Confluence link).

Outstanding issues / blockers
- Determinism: int4 hybrid run shows small non-determinism under repeated sequences when KV cache is reused. Hypothesis: precision of quantized matmul accumulation differs across kernels. Action: Jonah to instrument accumulators and log internal KV states for 3 failing sequences. (Owner: Jonah, due 2026-05-26)
- Eval gaps: no multiturn dialogue eval set that stresses long-term persona retention. Action: Priya to assemble ~200-dialogue test set from internal chat logs (anonymized). (Owner: Priya, due 2026-05-29)
- CI flakiness: nightly job occasionally times out on smaller testbeds. Action: Ethan to increase job timeout and add retry logic; also add a light smoke gate for quick feedback. (Owner: Ethan, due 2026-05-25)
- Legal sign-off on license compatibility (Owner: Marta, due 2026-05-24)

Short-term next steps (this week)
- Per-layer calibration: run layerwise MSE calibration pass focusing attention output and MLP first fc (Priya + Jonah). Target: reduce EM delta for int4 to <3%.
- Determinism probe: instrument and re-run stress tests (Jonah).
- Assemble long-dialog eval set and add to nightly regression (Priya).
- Update onboarding runbook with quant profiles and rollback guidance (Ethan + Marta).

Longer-term notes / ideas
- Explore mixed-kernel approach: keep attention in int8 but MLP in int4 to trade quality/latency. Add to backlog RWI-3032.
- Consider automatic profile selector in Optimize: route requests with high reasoning-sensitivity to int8 variant, lower-cost funnels to int4 for short responses. Needs A/B test framework linkage.
- Investigate kernel-level fp16 accumulation on int4 matmuls to improve determinism.

Meeting log snippets (casual capture)
- Jonah: "Layerwise calibration looked promising on toy model, but we see residual bias in softmax tails."
- Marta: "Legal needs the exact model lineage doc; I can turn around the sign-off once PR includes it."
- Ethan: "Nightly timeouts — small infra tweak will fix; I also added a quick smoke output sanity that fails fast."

Action items (summary)
- Jonah: instrument accumulators + determinism probe (due 2026-05-26).
- Priya: assemble anonymized long-dialog eval set (due 2026-05-29).
- Ethan: CI timeout + smoke gate (due 2026-05-25).
- Marta: legal license sign-off (due 2026-05-24).

Notes-to-self: keep draft descriptive names in PRs, avoid leaking raw customer data into eval sets, tag all runs with commit hash and gguf build id. Save final notes and push a cleaned version to Confluence before the end-of-week review.

Attachments / quick links
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/model-tools/pull/3456 (gguf + quant profiles)
- Perf traces: perf-db/redwood/may23-quant (internal)
- Jira: RWI-2987 (quant baseline), RWI-3032 (mixed-kernel research)

End of labnotes.

-- Priya (draft)
